attempts.prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Exactly ONE isolated unnamed Tibetan town building sprite for tianshu default kit. True RGBA transparent background with fully solid opaque building. Song reference is ONLY for restrained realistic weathered stone/wood materials and detail density, never for roof type. Tibetan vernacular: slightly battered whitewashed stone walls, flat earthen roof and low parapets, black trapezoidal door/window borders, muted red lintels and dark matte timber. NO pitched Chinese tile roofs, no tourist facades, no glass, no gold on ordinary houses. Orthographic yaw45 elevation30, STRICT2:1 dimetric ground slopes+0.5/-0.5, NO perspective. Original entrance on screen lower-left. Base is clear wall-foot parallelogram with left/front/right corners visible, NO plinth, NO terrain rectangle, NO outside objects. Left wall plane illuminated by upper-left light, right wall plane darker, very short lower-right contact shadow. Entire shape plus roof inside frame with at least10% transparent margins. No ambient halo or glow, no floor, sky, scenery, characters, symbols, readable text, checkerboard, watermark, toy/plastic look. Asset bld_kit_tubo_courtyard. Footprint10m east-west by8m north-south. a residential courtyard: two modest flat-roof stone wings along back and right, low rough white stone enclosing front walls and one central wooden south gate. Broad open compact-earth courtyard inside, a small wordless prayer-flag line above one roof corner and small plain stone mani pile INSIDE the yard. No inscriptions. One integrated rectangular footprint. Front and right sides nearly equal, left-front edge ratio1.25:1 to front-right edge.
